links.outcome: Clinician reaction to discrepant explanations from different XAI methods (disagreement problem)
links.effect: Discrepancies between explanations from different XAI methods were not a major concern to clinicians as long as the predictive alerts were accurate.
links.quote: Discrepancies in explanations generated by different XAI methods were not a major concern, provided that the AI-generated predictive alerts were accurate.

links.outcome: Clinician perceived value of explanations for AI predictive alerts
links.effect: Clinicians valued explainability, especially in complex or unfamiliar situations, when explanations were clear, plausible and actionable; its importance diminished with familiarity and expertise.
links.quote: Clinicians valued explainability, particularly in complex or unfamiliar situations, when explanations were clear, plausible, and actionable.

screen.reason: Qualitative study examining clinician perceptions and decision-making when presented with AI-generated explanations and discrepancies in explanations (XAI) within clinical decision support alerts.
